objective.summary: Produce a stable, evidence-backed Dev baseline; correct three false runtime contracts; reduce the live documentation surface and verified dead files; prevent Line overlay collisions; and move concrete ImageCanvas control/lifetime ownership out of the ViewModel while preserving behavior.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Preserve all pre-existing tracked and untracked user changes and distinguish new changes with the captured baseline.
Keep explicit Teach, Preview, and Run behavior and the x64 Windows/.NET 8 product identity unchanged.
Reuse existing concrete owners; add no speculative service, interface, wrapper, registry, folder, or Partial split.
Store generated test output, screenshots, and logs under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, communicate externally, or mutate hardware/platform integrations.

criteria.text: The pre-change branch, HEAD, status, tracked diff, and SHA-256 inventory are recorded outside the repository so existing work and this task can be distinguished.

The solution exposes no unsupported x86 configuration, embedded smoke failures return a nonzero process code, and NOTICE identifies the manifest-verified Vision SDK commit; focused checks prove each contract.

The live documentation route is compact and current, stale/duplicate control entries are removed or archived, and only locally proven dead files are deleted; documentation and source/build checks pass.
Line measurement and signal-diagnostic labels use a collision-safe layout, with focused rendering/runtime evidence and all unexercised DPI/theme/input scope stated.

RoiImageCanvasViewModel no longer creates, exposes, invokes, or disposes the concrete ImageCanvasControl; a View/presentation owner owns control creation and lifetime while the existing binding/public/consumer behavior passes focused contracts.

The final report records the product identity, executable/project graph route, MVVM conclusion, DLL portability boundary, completed checks, and every remaining unverified runtime risk without claiming commit, release, or hardware proof.

The 1,331-file documentation tree has a SHA-256 inventory; 944 text files have zero invalid UTF-8/JSON and zero missing inline relative links. The four live control documents are compact, old content is archived, 156 moved-archive links were rebased, and only verified dead source/config/media was removed.

Line label layout contract passes 5 checks for 12 labels. Final actual product EXE exits 0 with 37 px, 0.222 mm, and 24 detections; the window intersects DISPLAY2 and visual review confirms separated distance columns and top profile legend at 100% DPI.

RoiImageCanvasViewModel has no ImageCanvasControl creation, exposure, invocation, or disposal. RoiImageCanvasPresentation and its View/session callers own native lifetime; the 8-check owner contract and 6-check path contract pass. The actual external consumer exits 0 after 100 create/dispose cycles with handle delta -5 and valid overlay/view-state evidence on DISPLAY2.

The report records the executable/project graph route, practical MVVM conclusion, DLL dependency-closure boundary, deletions/retained candidates, full final checks, and unverified runtime scope. Debug/Release solution and relevant harness builds have zero warnings/errors; readiness, refactor audit, documentation, DLL, NOTICE, sample, and focused contracts pass.

Current-source Line layout contract passes 5 checks for 12 labels. The rebuilt actual product EXE exits 0 with 37 px, 0.222 mm, and 24 detections; its capture and tool windows intersect the dynamically selected DISPLAY2, and direct image review confirms separated distance-label columns and a top profile legend at 100% DPI. The final run reported one logical monitor; the earlier two-monitor run also placed the window on the smaller left DISPLAY2.

Current-source RoiImageCanvas owner and path contracts pass 8 and 6 checks. The rebuilt actual external consumer exits 0 after Borrow/Clone/TakeOwnership, view-state round-trip, selection, and 100 create/dispose cycles with handle delta +2 (within the <=8 gate), and its window is inside the dynamically selected DISPLAY2.

After the final source adjustment, Debug and Release solution builds plus embedded product, VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke, and PipelineViewerScreenshotSmoke builds have zero warnings and errors. Readiness 13 categories, refactor audit, documentation index and full 1,331-file scan, external DLL Debug/Release, NOTICE provenance, public sample assets, three focused contracts, unknown-smoke exit propagation, x86 rejection, static ownership checks, and git diff check pass. The report preserves the DLL dependency-closure conclusion and all unverified runtime and release boundaries.
